description: 覆盖 privacy current_links mask 与 write_control protected 的运行态增删查改路径。

phases.name: privacy_mask_add_first_core

phases.name: privacy_mask_list_after_add
phases.command: redstonelink link privacy current_links mask list core

phases.name: privacy_mask_set_two_cores
phases.commandTemplate: redstonelink link privacy current_links mask set core {{targets[0,1]:mixed}} confirm

phases.name: privacy_mask_list_after_set
phases.command: redstonelink link privacy current_links mask list core

phases.name: protected_add_first_core

phases.name: protected_list_after_set
phases.command: redstonelink link write_control protected list core

phases.name: privacy_mask_remove_second_core
phases.commandTemplate: redstonelink link privacy current_links mask remove core {{targets[1]}}

phases.name: privacy_mask_list_after_remove
phases.command: redstonelink link privacy current_links mask list core

phases.name: protected_list_after_remove
